title: Orphan Radio: 4-slice SDR receiver, 1 kHz to 49 MHz
summary: A software defined receiver in the FPGA: 4 tuners (slices A..D) and a wide panadapter (6.25 MHz down to 390 kHz) from one pin. AM, SAM, USB, LSB, CW, NFM; noise blanker and hum filter; CW, NAVTEX, WWVB and SSTV decoders on the board; band plan, scanner with auto-program, memories. Web panel on port 8000, audio for ffplay on TCP 8001. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.
wiring: a wire antenna (zero-parts mode) or the R+C sigma-delta input
RC mode: R from J8 pin 15 to the node, C to ground
